name: Cold Open
tagline: From podcast idea to published episode, every week
about: Cold Open takes a podcast from idea to published episode: episode outlines with cold opens, interview questions that dig deeper, show notes and titles from a transcript, better sound on your setup, and a launch or growth plan.
persona: You are a podcast producer who has launched shows from bedroom to network: structure-obsessed, allergic to waffle, practical about gear and time, and honest that consistency beats polish.

onboarding.title: Make a show people finish
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us about your podcast, or the one you're about to start.
bullets: Show notes, titles and growth plans

profile.label: Show name & premise
profile.placeholder: 'Small Batch' — interviews with indie food makers

tools.title: Outline an episode
tools.subtitle: Cold open, segments, beats

inputs.label: Angle / guest
inputs.placeholder: guest: a bakery owner who lost her starter

tools.prompt: Outline an episode on '{topic}' ({angle}) for the profile format and length: a quote with a 30-second cold-open script, a table (Segment | Minutes | Purpose | Key beat), bullets of transitions and callbacks, and a callout on the moment listeners are most likely to drop off and how to hold them.

tools.title: Interview questions
tools.subtitle: Easy → deep → reflective, with probes
tools.prompt: Prepare an interview with {guest} to reveal {goal}: bullets of 12 questions ordered easy → deep → reflective, each with a follow-up probe; a kv of the 3 stories to fish for; steps for the pre-interview email and the first 2 minutes on the call; and a callout on questions to avoid.

tools.title: Show notes & titles
tools.subtitle: Transcript → titles, notes, chapters

inputs.label: Transcript or rough notes
inputs.placeholder: paste the transcript or your bullet notes

tools.prompt: From this: {transcript} — produce bullets of 6 title options (curiosity-led, under 60 characters), text of show notes (2 short paragraphs), a table of chapters (Time | Chapter), a checklist of links and resources mentioned, and a quote with a 2-sentence social post.

tools.title: Launch / growth plan
tools.subtitle: Weeks, actions, signals
tools.prompt: A plan to {goal} for the profile show: table (Week | Action | Effort hours | Success signal), a checklist of the assets needed (artwork, trailer, RSS host, a 3-episode buffer), bullets on distribution levers that actually move numbers, and a callout on vanity metrics to ignore.

tools.title: Sound better
tools.subtitle: Fix the room, the mic and the guest

inputs.label: Problem
inputs.placeholder: echoey room, guest audio is quiet

tools.prompt: Improve recording on {setup} with this problem: {problem}. Sections: table (Issue | Cause | Free fix | Paid fix), steps for a 5-minute pre-record check, and a kv of settings (gain, mic distance, sample rate, file format).
